nodes.title: Input Parameters
widgets_values:
## Input Parameters

Encodes both prompts and derives fps + frame count.

The positive prompt optionally goes through the enhancer first; the effective prompt actually used is previewed below.

If an LTX API key is present the API text encoder is used instead of the local one.

nodes.title: Preprocess
widgets_values:
## Preprocess

Builds an empty audio latent at the requested length and concatenates it with the audio-only video latent stub the model expects.

nodes.title: Generate
widgets_values:
## Generate

Runs the diffusion over the sigma schedule, then splits the A/V latent and keeps the audio track.

Audio is more sensitive to the schedule than video - explore samplers and sigmas here.

nodes.title: Decode
widgets_values:
## Decode

Decodes the audio latent through the audio VAE.

nodes.title: Preview
widgets_values:
## Preview audio

Play the result, or swap in a Save Audio node to write it to disk.

nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

Text-to-audio uses the **audio VAE** and the **audio-only** wrapper around the diffusion model. There is no video VAE and no spatial upscaler in this flow.

## Model Links

**LTX-2.5 Model Weights**

Make sure to click the "Agree and Access" button the first time you download.

- [ Distilled model - ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors)

- [ Audio VAE - ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors)


**Text Encoder - finetuned for LTX-2.5**
- [gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors)

**Text Enhancer**
- [Google Gemma 4 E2B IT](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/gemma-4/blob/main/text_encoders/gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors)


**Model Storage Location**

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │      ├── gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors
│   │      └── gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors
```

## Report Issues
To report any issues when running this workflow, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)

nodes.title: Inputs
widgets_values:
## Inputs

Text-to-audio takes **no image and no video** - only text and a length.

### Prompt

Enter a positive prompt. To rewrite it into a fuller description first, enable
**enhance positive prompt** on the Input Parameters node below. The negative
prompt is used as written and is never enhanced.

Supplying an **LTX API key** encodes and enhances the prompt through the API
instead of locally, which saves memory. The workflow switches over on its own
whenever a key is present - there is nothing to un-bypass.

See the [prompting guide](https://docs.ltx.io/open-source-model/usage-guides/prompting-guide).
### Frame rate and duration

Set both below. The frame count has to be 1 + a multiple of 8, so the duration
actually used is worked out from the fps and the duration you ask for, and may
come out slightly different.

widgets_values: Do explore various samplers and cfg values (although we advise them to be kept close to 1)
